Class ChestUpgradeRules

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.upgrade.ChestUpgradeRules
public final class ChestUpgradeRules extends Object
What a chest becomes with a set of upgrades, and which upgrade changes are allowed.

    • getRemovalProblems

      public static ResizeResult getRemovalProblems(ChestStorage storage, int size, UpgradeSet upgrades, ChestUpgrade upgrade)
      Removing an upgrade is refused if contents would not fit: a filled slot over its new capacity, or a filled slot beyond the new slot count. Slots that are already over capacity only count if the capacity changes.
      Parameters:
      storage - The chest storage.
      size - The structure size.
      upgrades - The installed upgrades.
      upgrade - The upgrade to remove.
      Returns:
      The slots that keep the upgrade from being removed, empty if it can be removed.
